snippet.title: Dino Pet Walker - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
What if walking your pet dinosaur wasn’t so easy?

Dino Pet Walker is a casual fantasy game where you take on the role of May, a girl responsible for walking and caring for dinosaurs in a vibrant voxel world inspired by Brazilian biomes.

Relax, explore, and solve challenges… but be careful, your dino might have other plans.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4318730/Dino_Pet_Walker/


🦖 About the Game

🌿 A Cozy Dino Adventure
• Walk and care for your own dinosaur companion
• Experience a relaxing and playful fantasy world

🧠 Puzzle and Exploration
• Solve environmental challenges
• Navigate situations where your dino may not cooperate

🎮 Dynamic Companion System
• Your dinosaur has moods and behaviors
• If it gets stressed, it may break free and run away

🌎 A Unique World
• Voxel-style visuals inspired by Brazilian environments
• A society where humans and dinosaurs coexist

👧 Meet May
• Play as a caretaker navigating daily challenges
• Balance fun, responsibility, and chaos
